lede: Monolingual Shan accounts for 11 catalogued manuscripts, 2 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (91% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Phrae. Nearly all (91%) are written in Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ script. Dated witnesses run 1937–1967 CE (6 of 11 carry a date).
